rationale: Acceptance did not run (no spec), so confidence is low. renderPane reads slot._children, which exists only on test fakes, so it throws on any selection in the real DOM. 17 candidates were dismissed as noise or handled, and none were deferred.

findings.title: Busy label shown on the wrong agent's pane
findings.problem: redrawPane passes busy: inFlight.size > 0 and action: runningAction for whichever agent is selected, with nothing tying runningAction to the agent that owns it. Selecting agent B while agent A installs labels B's Install button 'Installing…'.
findings.impact: The pane tells the user something is installing for an agent nothing is happening to.
findings.recommendation: Track the in-flight agent's command and pass action only when it equals the selected agent; keep busy true for all so buttons stay disabled.

findings.title: renderPane throws in the real DOM
findings.problem: renderPane checks slot._children.length. el() returns a real HTMLElement from document.createElement, which has no _children, so this is a TypeError. Only the test fake DOM defines _children.
findings.impact: Selecting any agent, or any renderAgents call with a selection, throws and the detail pane never draws. This is the feature's core deliverable.
findings.recommendation: Use `if (slot.childElementCount) pane.appendChild(slot);`, or make the test fake expose childElementCount.

findings.title: No end-to-end test of the newer-than-supported state
findings.problem: update-check-newer.txt is exercised only by the parser test, and the join and UI tests use hand-built records. No controller test runs the fixture through load and asserts the pane text and actions.
findings.impact: If the controller stopped passing the parsed records to the join, or the names diverged, the pane would show 'Installed 2.1.290' and drop the notice while every layer's test still passed.
findings.recommendation: Add a controller test using fakeRunCapture with update-check-newer.txt that selects Claude Code and asserts 'Newer than CodeMie supports' and only a Remove button.

findings.title: stopPropagation on action buttons is untested
findings.problem: The test 'clicking a row selects it, clicking its button does not' only clicks the row. Every button-click test passes a no-op stopPropagation stub that asserts nothing.
findings.impact: Removing e?.stopPropagation?.() at agents-ui.js:180 would make every Install/Update/Remove click also select the row and redraw the pane, and no test would fail.
findings.recommendation: Click a row action button with an event stub that records stopPropagation, and assert it was called and onSelect was not.

findings.title: Commit subjects lack the documented type prefix
findings.problem: git-workflow.md requires '<type>: <short description>' with a type from feat|fix|docs|test|chore|refactor. Commits 9b5bee9, 172b697, c732a84 and 74592b8 use 'EPMCDME-14655 : ...' with no type.
findings.impact: Commit subjects do not match the documented commit format that the workflow gate checks.
findings.recommendation: Reword the subjects to the documented form, or update git-workflow.md if the ticket-prefixed style is the intended convention.
